edits.js: const e = document.querySelectorAll(".switch")[0]; if (e) { const c = e.cloneNode(true); for (const n of c.querySelectorAll('*')) if (!n.children.length && n.textContent.trim()) n.textContent = "Export"; if (!c.children.length) c.textContent = "Export"; c.setAttribute('aria-label', "Export"); e.parentNode.appendChild(c); }
